sources.title: Gemini 3.6 Flash model card
sources.evidence: Identifies Gemini 3.6 Flash as a Gemini 3 multimodal reasoning model, based on 3.5 Flash. Its Architecture section explicitly delegates to the 3.5 Flash card. Distribution is through Google hosted apps and APIs; no parameter totals are given.

sources.title: Gemini 3.6 Flash API model specification
sources.evidence: Exact stable model code gemini-3.6-flash: 1,048,576 input tokens, 65,536 output tokens; text/image/video/audio/PDF inputs and text output. Thinking and function calling are supported.

sources.title: Introducing Gemini 3.6 Flash, 3.5 Flash-Lite, and 3.5 Flash Cyber
sources.evidence: July 21, 2026 announcement says 3.6 Flash is available starting that day. Describes the Flash series and improved coding, multimodal work and token efficiency over 3.5 Flash.

sources.title: Gemini 3.5 Flash model card
sources.evidence: The exact architecture reference from the 3.6 card. Its Architecture section explicitly refers to the Gemini 3 Flash model card; it provides no numeric total or active parameter count.

sources.title: Gemini 3 Flash model card, December 2025
sources.evidence: Page 2 explicitly refers to Gemini 3 Pro for architecture. No numeric total or active parameter count is disclosed.

sources.title: Gemini 3 Pro model card, updated May 2026
sources.evidence: Page 3 identifies sparse mixture-of-experts Transformer architecture with native multimodal inputs and a routed subset of parameters per token. Reached through explicit architecture references from 3.6 Flash to 3.5 Flash to 3 Flash; no parameter counts supplied.

sources.title: Gemini API Additional Terms of Service
sources.evidence: Terms for the hosted Gemini API prohibit extracting or replicating underlying model weights. Together with the exact model distribution section, supports a proprietary service classification, not an open-weight license.

sources.title: Gemini 3.7 Flash model card, August 2026
sources.evidence: Later card explicitly compares Gemini 3.6 Flash in a labeled benchmark column and references it as a dependency. Neither the comparison nor surrounding model information discloses 3.6 total or active parameters.

sources.title: Gemini 3.8 Flash model card, September 2026
sources.evidence: Later model card checked for retrospective specifications. It supplies no total or active parameter count for Gemini 3.6 Flash.

sources.title: Gemini 4 Argon model card, October 2026
sources.evidence: Later model card checked for retrospective specifications; no Gemini 3.6 Flash total or active count is supplied.

sources.title: Models.dev Gemini 3.6 Flash record
sources.evidence: Baseline catalog lead inspected. Primary Google sources independently establish the model identity and public specifications; this catalog does not establish internal parameter counts.

name.note: Official name of stable gemini-3.6-flash; distinct from 3.5 Flash and 3.5 Flash-Lite.

developer.note: Released by Google and documented by Google DeepMind.

family.note: Catalog-normalized family key for the official Gemini Flash series.

release_date.note: The dated announcement explicitly says available starting today; confirms earliest public launch, not a later provider rollout.

open_weights.note: Documented distribution is hosted apps/APIs under Google terms; downloadable model weights are not distributed in the primary materials.

license.note: Descriptive classification of hosted model access governed by Google service terms; documentation/code licenses are not model-weight licenses.

parameters_b.note: No exact-model total count found in the model-card reference chain or later cards checked. Exact-name primary training/interpretability and parameter searches found no additional disclosure. No sibling counts inferred.

active_parameters_b.note: Sparse routing is documented, but no numeric count of active parameters for 3.6 Flash is disclosed in the primary materials checked. Total and active are not equated.

architecture.note: Explicit Architecture references: 3.6 Flash -> 3.5 Flash -> Gemini 3 Flash -> Gemini 3 Pro. The final referenced card specifies a sparse MoE Transformer. This establishes architecture class only, not expert counts or identical size.

context_window.note: Exact API input-token limit; separate output maximum is 65,536 tokens.

modalities.note: Matches the exact stable API model supported input/output data types; PDF is retained as the catalog input-format convention.

reasoning.note: Model card calls it a reasoning model and API capability table supports Thinking.

tool_call.note: Exact API model specification explicitly supports function calling.

description.value: Gemini Flash model for coding and multimodal tasks, with text output, thinking and function calling.
description.note: Replaces broad speed/cost marketing with supported model purpose, output type and capability.

patch.notes: Sparse MoE Transformer architecture is supported by explicit model-card architecture references from 3.6 Flash through 3.5 Flash and Gemini 3 Flash to Gemini 3 Pro. Total and active parameter counts remain undisclosed in the primary materials checked, including later comparison cards.

summary: Audited all 14 public fields. Adds proprietary license classification and sparse MoE architecture through the explicit first-party reference chain; refines description and promotes source provenance to primary. Confirms July 21, 2026 release, 1,048,576 input tokens, multimodal inputs, text output, reasoning and function calling. Total and active parameters remain null/undisclosed after checking exact-model sources, later cards and training/interpretability searches. Evidence cached in /tmp/model-audit-210.
